system_description.narrative_title: AI investment boom strains finance, yields and policy
system_description.narrative_summary: A surge in AI investment and hyperscaler expansion is supporting growth but is creating heavy capital demand, leverage and supply constraints across the tech chain. Those pressures are interacting with higher inflation, rising bond yields and volatile FX moves, forcing central banks, investors and policymakers into trade-offs between growth, financial stability and AI safety/regulation. The result is a tightly coupled open system where capital flows, macro policy and AI industry dynamics feed back on one another and can produce disorderly market moves or a self-reinforcing slowdown.
system_description.scope: Within the system boundary: AI investment and deployment (hyperscalers, models, chips), tech supply chains (semiconductors, data centers), capital markets (bond yields, credit, FX), monetary and fiscal policy responses, inflation dynamics, and regulatory/safety debates — plus feedbacks among funding, asset prices, and real economic activity.
system_description.super_system: Global macro-financial system (international capital flows, commodity markets, geopolitics and global growth)
adjacent_subsystems: Tech supply chain and semiconductor industry
Labor markets, employment policy and social safety nets

variables.name: AI investment rate
variables.description: Net flow of financial investment directed specifically toward AI development, models, and related projects per unit time.

variables.name: Technology capex rate
variables.description: Rate of capital expenditure across the technology production chain (data centers, hardware, tooling) per unit time.

variables.name: AI compute capacity
variables.description: Installed stock of purpose-built AI processing capacity (accelerators, clusters, specialized appliances) available to run large models.

variables.name: Semiconductor capacity utilization
variables.description: Proportion of available semiconductor fabrication and tool capacity currently in productive use.

variables.name: Supply‑chain bottleneck intensity
variables.description: Aggregate severity of material, component and logistics constraints in the tech supply chain limiting throughput.

variables.name: Systemic leverage ratio
variables.description: Average ratio of debt to equity (or assets) across financial and non‑financial sectors relevant to technology funding.

variables.name: Corporate credit spread
variables.description: Average premium demanded by lenders over risk‑free rates to hold corporate debt, reflecting credit risk and financing costs.

variables.name: Long‑term bond yield level
variables.description: Representative long‑term nominal yield in sovereign and high‑grade bond markets that sets the benchmark cost of capital.

variables.name: Bond market liquidity
variables.description: Ease and depth with which bonds can be bought and sold without large price impact.

variables.name: FX volatility
variables.description: Magnitude and frequency of exchange‑rate fluctuations across major currency pairs.

variables.name: Inflation rate
variables.description: Rate of change in the general price level of goods and services over time.

variables.name: Monetary policy stance
variables.description: Aggregate stance of monetary policy measured by policy rates, balance‑sheet settings and forward guidance tightness.

variables.name: Fiscal policy flexibility
variables.description: Degree of fiscal headroom and willingness to adjust government spending and borrowing in response to shocks.

variables.name: Capital flows to technology
variables.description: Net financial flows moving into the technology sector from domestic and international investors per unit time.

variables.name: Investor risk appetite
variables.description: Aggregate investor willingness to take on risky, growth‑oriented positions relative to safe assets.

variables.name: AI regulatory intensity
variables.description: Overall strictness and enforcement intensity of regulatory and oversight frameworks applied to AI development and deployment.

catalysts.title: Next Fed policy decision
catalysts.description: The upcoming Fed meeting could tighten policy in response to hot CPI, directly shifting yields and the cost of capital for AI investments.
catalysts.rationale: Hot CPI and Fed speakers put another hike back on table (e.g. 'US inflation heats up', 'Fed rate hike call seen tight').

catalysts.title: Ongoing hotter-than-expected inflation prints
catalysts.description: A string of higher CPI/wholesale prints will keep upward pressure on yields and tighten monetary policy expectations.
catalysts.rationale: 'Broad Pickup in Prices Lifted Inflation to 3.7%' and 'The latest inflation data is expected...' drive further prints.

catalysts.title: ASML: AI demand exceeds chip-tool capacity through 2028
catalysts.description: Persistent mismatch between AI-driven demand and chip-tool supply will keep semiconductor capacity tight and strain tech supply chains.
catalysts.rationale: ASML warns 'AI demand will exceed chip-tool capacity through 2028' and 'AI demand to exceed supply for 2 more years'.

catalysts.title: Hyperscalers expand in-house chips and supercomputers
catalysts.description: Major cloud and AI firms are deploying proprietary chips and building supercomputers, rapidly increasing available AI compute and capex needs.
catalysts.rationale: 'Microsoft plans huge deployment of its own AI chips' and 'Scaleway to build AMD-powered AI supercomputer' show rapid expansion.

catalysts.title: Banking and financial watchdogs increase AI scrutiny
catalysts.description: Regulators are intensifying oversight of AI in finance; supervisory reviews and guidance will change compliance costs and lending behaviour.
catalysts.rationale: 'EXCLUSIVE: Banking watchdogs ramp up AI scrutiny' and IMF/World Bank warnings increase oversight pressure.

catalysts.title: Anthropic revenue and financial disclosure
catalysts.description: Anthropic's forthcoming revenue figures will influence investor sentiment toward AI labs and valuation-driven funding flows.
catalysts.rationale: 'Anthropic to disclose new revenue numbers' makes lab financials central to the AI trade.

catalysts.title: Near-term bond market pressure and liquidity strain
catalysts.description: Rising yields, auction pressures and hedging flows could spike yields and worsen liquidity, feeding back to corporate borrowing costs.
catalysts.rationale: '10-year Treasury yield jumps' and 'Bond Vigilantes Find New Reasons to Worry' highlight ongoing bond stress.

catalysts.title: IMF pushes fiscal consolidation and debt warnings
catalysts.description: IMF pressure for deficit reduction and warnings about short-term debt could constrain government spending and raise sovereign borrowing costs.
catalysts.rationale: 'IMF calls for US to cut deficits' and 'IMF dials up calls for urgent fiscal consolidation' foreground fiscal tightening risks.
